name: medmunds/puzzles
embed_notes: Emscripten build of Tatham's C sources; gh-pages hosts a prebuilt playable copy (html/index.html, html/puzzle.html + js/ glue). Touch-friendly with virtual keyboard.
reskin_notes: Colours are per-puzzle in C (game_colours); shell chrome is LESS/CSS. Reskin = CSS shell + logo, not sprites.
score_hook: JS glue (js/puzzle.js, events.js, message.js) receives status-bar/COMPLETED messages from C; hook there and postMessage.
notes: MULTI-GAME GOLD: ~36 classic puzzle games in one MIT repo (unmaintained since 2013; author points to puzzles-web).

name: medmunds/puzzles-web
embed_notes: Vite + Emscripten WASM PWA; needs toolchain to build (Docker dir provided). Deployed on Cloudflare (wrangler).
reskin_notes: TS UI shell (src/*.ts dialogs) + CSS; puzzle drawing colours still in C.
score_hook: Status/complete messages from WASM surface in TS UI layer -> add postMessage in the completion handler.
notes: Maintained successor to medmunds/puzzles; low stars but active in 2026. Best modern base for the Tatham collection (upstream mirror: ghewgill/puzzles, 221 stars, MIT, C).

name: increpare/PuzzleScript
embed_notes: Editor exports a single self-contained HTML file per game; engine itself is static JS. Thousands of open PuzzleScript games exist (many CC/MIT).
reskin_notes: Sprites are 5x5 text-art + palette inside the game script; title/text/colors all in one plain-text source. Swap sprites for mascot in minutes (low-res only).
score_hook: Engine has win-condition evaluation (winconditions / 'win' state, level change) in engine.js; exported HTML exposes globals to hook.
notes: MULTI-GAME GOLD: engine + huge library of tiny reskinnable puzzle games.

name: kaifansariw/GameHub
embed_notes: frontend/public/games/ holds ~50 standalone HTML/JS mini-games (each a folder or single .html) - iframe-able directly; the React/Django portal shell is optional.
reskin_notes: Each game is a small html/css/js; styles mostly inline per game (common-game.css shared). No sprite packs - mostly CSS/emoji.
score_hook: Portal already posts scores to a REST API (/api/...), so each game has a score variable + submit point to redirect to postMessage.
notes: MULTI-GAME: low stars but a ready-made arcade portal with dozens of static mini-games under MIT.

name: our-mini-games/mini-games
embed_notes: pnpm workspace, packages/<game>; needs build. Deployed to gh-pages.
reskin_notes: Vue components per game; CSS-based.
score_hook: Per-package state; no unified event.
notes: MULTI-GAME but NO LICENSE -> unusable unless author adds one. Flagged.

name: digitsensitive/phaser3-typescript
embed_notes: Webpack/TS build per game (src/games/<name>); each game is standalone once built.
reskin_notes: Phaser: every sprite lives in per-game assets folders (src/games/<game>/assets); swap PNGs + config consts.
score_hook: Phaser scenes hold score in scene data/registry; emit on game-over scene start.
notes: MULTI-GAME: well-known Phaser 3 example collection incl. a match-3; most games belong to the arcade slice.

name: freeboardgames/FreeBoardGames.org
embed_notes: Next.js monorepo with server; not trivially iframe-able per game.
reskin_notes: React components per game; some SVG assets.
score_hook: boardgame.io ctx.gameover per game.
notes: MULTI-GAME but AGPL (copyleft, network clause) - flagged. Useful reference for board-game rules code.

name: gabrielecirulli/2048
embed_notes: index.html + js/ + style/; no build (Rakefile only for CSS).
reskin_notes: All colours in style/main.css (tile classes .tile-2 ...); text in index.html; no sprites - add background-image per tile class for mascot faces.
score_hook: GameManager.score / .over / .won; HTMLActuator.actuate() gets {score, over, won, bestScore} every move -> one-line postMessage.
notes: The canonical 2048; cleanest possible score hook.

name: gd4Ark/2048
embed_notes: index.html + js/ (config.js, game.js, view.js) + css/; zero build.
reskin_notes: js/config.js + css/style.css (keyframes, media); no images.
score_hook: game.js tracks score and game-over state; view.js renders it.
notes: Small modern vanilla 2048 with separate config/view - easy fork.

name: mmazzarolo/ordinary-puzzles-app
embed_notes: Expo web build (config-overrides/metro); public/ served as static SPA after build. Also on app stores.
reskin_notes: Minimal flat design; colours/typography in theme constants; no sprites to swap.
score_hook: Puzzle-solved state in game store (levels/completion) -> emit on solve.
notes: Polished original logic puzzle, 2026-active; RN-web means heavier bundle.

name: chrisheninger/matchimals.fun
